review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial review (fresh general-purpose agent, radar renderer cohort, 2026-11-14, task a78aba37d54c5d977)
review.note: Final verdict APPROVE after one re-review. The first pass returned REQUEST CHANGES on one MAJOR and one MINOR, both in this family's validator. MAJOR: is_value_list treated any empty comma slot as skippable, so leading ('{,1}'), internal ('{1,,2}') and repeated ('{1,,}') commas drew even though only a single optional trailing comma is grammar-legal (the reviewer found 4,980 distinct fail-open shapes across 26,334 combinations); it now accepts an empty piece only as the final slot after a real element, with inline and block regression pins. MINOR: an empty multi-line curve block was accepted while an inline '{}' was rejected; a block must now contain at least one value line before its closing brace. The reviewer independently reproduced the 3/3/0 partition with two methods, ran 140 hand probes, the 26,334-case differential and 60,000 fuzzed inputs with no crash, hang or non-verbatim emission, and confirmed the trim-before-colon frontmatter gate and printable-ASCII literal hardening. The NITs (quoted YAML visual keys shared with three approved siblings, over-broad ':::' substring gate, the nominal row-count off-by-one re-gated downstream, and asymmetric body-gate prefixes) are fail-safe or faithful with no corpus sample and are unchanged per the blast-radius rule.
